name: The Longwalkers
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Hail, champion. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place?

I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain.

All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape.

Are you up to the task?
narrative.objectives: Help Perith Stormhoof escape Palemane Rock, and report his safety to Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.
narrative.offerRewardText: I am relieved that Longwalker Stormhoof is well. He is my most trusted scout, and his mission of the utmost importance.Please, accept my thanks and my hospitality for riskng your life to save his own. You have done a greater service to our people than you know.I encourage you to explore our great city while you are here. It is a place of safety, and you will find many that may aid you on your own travels upon its bluffs.Ish-ne-alo por-ah.
